summary: Client profiles accept env:NAME credentials without 1Password while retaining live tenant identity verification and every expected identity assertion.
reason: Cloud hosts receive credentials through environment variables. Resolve values only into process memory, fail by variable name when unset or empty, and persist or display references only.
validated_outcome: Regression tests cover set, unset, empty, rotated and mixed credentials, all six expected identity assertions, and absence of resolved values in output or persisted artifacts.
